mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT SPECIAL.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, SPECIAL.IS_ABS isAbs, SPECIAL.IS_SPECIAL_DEBT isSpecialDebt, SPECIAL.IS_DEFAULT_BOND_INDICATOR isDefaultBondIndicator, SPECIAL.INPUT_TYPE inputType, PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr FROM FIN_PRODUCT_SPECIAL SPECIAL INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PRODUCT ON SPECIAL.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID UNION SELECT SPECIAL.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, SPECIAL.IS_ABS isAbs, SPECIAL.IS_SPECIAL_DEBT isSpecialDebt, SPECIAL.IS_DEFAULT_BOND_INDICATOR isDefaultBondIndicator, SPECIAL.INPUT_TYPE inputType, INTERF.SECNAME finprodAbbr FROM FIN_PRODUCT_SPECIAL SPECIAL INNER JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO INTERF ON SPECIAL.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = INTERF.SECID WHERE INTERF.SECID NOT IN (SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' AND TRADE_MARKET = '01') )

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_MARKET_ID NOT IN ( SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT_SPECIAL ) AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' AND TRADE_MARKET = '01' UNION SELECT SECID FINPROD_MARKET_ID, SECNAME FINPROD_ABBR FROM INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO PAYHSRCSECINFO LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_SPECIAL SPECIAL ON PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID = SPECIAL.FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID NOT IN ( SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' AND TRADE_MARKET = '01' ) AND PAYHSRCSECINFO.MARKET = '01' AND PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID NOT IN ( SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT_SPECIAL ) )
AND ( finprodMarketId LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR finprodAbbr LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
